name: Venomancer: the Ealdir Attire disguise stays on through Spider and Beetle Form (#9383)
contract: Issue #9383. Clicking Dead Ealdmaine Ealdir 164225 during Ealdmaine Caverns 175036 gives a male character
Ealdir Attire 365016 (SPELL_AURA_TRANSFORM 164535). coa_transform_presets shows it as preset display 49 with
UNIT_FLAG2_MIRROR_IMAGE and the preset's mirror-image look. Shifting into Spider Form 800841 (form 52, display
194404) or Beetle Form 803183 (form 53, display 110063) replaced the display with the form model while the
mirror-image flag and look stayed, so the client drew no body; leaving the form restored 142949, whose baked
NPC texture a player leaves invisible. Expected: while the attire is on, the disguise display 49 stays through
shifting in and out, and removing the attire hands the display back to the form.

steps.label: Join world phase 1, where the corpse is spawned
Let the corpse reach the client
Take Ealdmaine Caverns beside the corpse
Click the corpse
SETUP: the male Ealdir Attire is applied
SETUP: the disguise shows the preset display
SETUP: Spider Form is active
DISCRIMINATING: Spider Form keeps the disguise display
The attire stays on in Spider Form
SETUP: Spider Form is gone
DISCRIMINATING: leaving Spider Form keeps the disguise display
Let the global cooldown pass
SETUP: Beetle Form is active
DISCRIMINATING: Beetle Form keeps the disguise display
DISCRIMINATING: leaving Beetle Form keeps the disguise display
Let the global cooldown pass
SETUP: Spider Form is active again
SETUP: the attire is removed
CONTROL: without the attire Spider Form shows the spider
CONTROL: leaving the form restores the character model
